review_method: Each quotation was read off the cited page of the stored searchable copy and recorded verbatim, including the scanned document's own OCR spellings. The builder re-locates every quote in that copy's text layer and records quote_located false rather than asserting a highlight it cannot produce. These are the citations for documents that carry no WS9 reviewed grade evidence; they state what the record says, not a grade conclusion. The Idaho Mineral Property File IF0131_001 is deliberately absent: the WS12 harvest rights gate logged it rights_unverified (a shared corporate property file with no established public-domain basis) and skipped it, and this store honours the same determination rather than storing it because it happens to be reachable.
